data.final_week_advice: Prioritize timed practice and mixed review in the final weeks to simulate exam conditions and reinforce weak areas like limits and continuity.
data.summary: This 16-week plan begins by addressing the student's weakness in Unit 1 (Limits and Continuity) during the first half, leveraging the live class in Week 2. The middle weeks progress through differentiation and integration units, ensuring all topics are covered. The final two weeks are dedicated to mixed review and timed practice to solidify understanding before the exam.

tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on estimating limits from graphs and tables, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on algebraic properties of limits

weeks.focus: Reinforcing limits through live instruction and practice
tasks: Attend live class on Unit 1 topics
Do 10 free-response questions on defining limits and using limit notation, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 15-question multiple-choice set on estimating limit values
Do 10 free-response questions on average and instantaneous rates of change, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on defining the derivative and using derivative notation

weeks.focus: Applying the chain rule and implicit differentiation
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on the chain rule, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 15-question multiple-choice set on implicit differentiation

weeks.focus: Interpreting derivatives in context and related rates
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on straight-line motion and related rates, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on interpreting the meaning of the derivative

weeks.focus: Analytical applications of differentiation and MVT
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on the Mean Value Theorem and extreme value theorem, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 15-question multiple-choice set on determining intervals of increase/decrease
Do 10 free-response questions on approximating areas with Riemann sums, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on summation notation and definite integral notation

weeks.focus: Modeling with differential equations and slope fields
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on modeling situations with differential equations, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 15-question multiple-choice set on sketching and reasoning with slope fields

weeks.focus: Applications of integration and area between curves
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on finding the average value of a function, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on finding the area between curves
Do 10 free-response questions on limits and continuity, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on estimating limit values
Do 10 free-response questions on the chain rule and implicit differentiation, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 15-question multiple-choice set on derivative notation

weeks.focus: Reviewing contextual and analytical applications of differentiation
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on related rates and the Mean Value Theorem, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on extreme value theorem

weeks.focus: Reviewing integration and accumulation of change
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on Riemann sums and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 15-question multiple-choice set on definite integral notation

weeks.focus: Reviewing differential equations and applications of integration
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on slope fields and area between curves, then mark them against the scoring guide
Complete a 20-question multiple-choice set on modeling with differential equations
Complete a full timed practice exam (multiple choice and free response)
Review incorrect answers and identify weak areas

weeks.focus: Final timed practice and exam preparation
tasks: Complete a second full timed practice exam
Review scoring guides and refine problem-solving strategies
